body.statement: On the complete rank-one alternating-factor calibration array with \(c_{\mathrm{loc}}=1/2\), let \(p_t=1+\tfrac12(-1)^t\). In the target chart \(I_{it}\times J_{it}\), the exact formula \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}/\psi=\sqrt{(3/4+1/n)\{1/2+4p_t^2/(5n)\}}\) implies \(\inf_{i,t}\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}/\psi>c_{\mathrm{loc}}\) for all sufficiently large \(n\) and \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}/\psi\to\sqrt{3/8}\). Direct contraction of the rank-one projector Hessian against the moving-average covariance in that same chart gives \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}\,\mathbb E[q_{it}(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}\epsilon)\mid M]\to-6\sqrt{3/2}\,p_t/(5\sqrt5)\), and therefore \(\psi\,\mathbb E[q_{it}(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}\epsilon)\mid M]\to\kappa^{\mathrm{drift}}_t=-2\gamma(1)p_t(n/m)(1-\rho_{\mathrm{alt}}^2)/(1+\rho_{\mathrm{alt}}^2)^{3/2}=-12p_t/(5\sqrt5)\) for every fixed parity of \(t\in W\). Thus the global-signal limits are \(-18/(5\sqrt5)\) for even targets and \(-6/(5\sqrt5)\) for odd targets, and \(\psi B_2\to-12/(5\sqrt5)\) because the consecutive window contains equally many targets of each parity. For the native masked optimizer with \(\lambda_n=4\sqrt n\log(n+2)\) and \(\psi=n^{4/5}\), the fitted correction removes this drift and \(n\{(gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it})-L-\widehat B_2\}\to_{\mathbb P}0\).
body.justification: The explicit parity constants replace an unsupported universal value and make the early kill test reproducible for the precise mask, factor normalization, dependence law, and penalty used by the native optimizer.
body.gap: Neither the independent-noise MNAR theorem nor fully observed leave-neighbor PCA contains this masked rank-projection coefficient.
body.consumer: A closed-form calibration case detects omitted interior overlap or regularization terms before empirical use.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove the native masked-optimizer and fitted-correction raw bounds in the sibling second-order transfer theorem; after those bounds are available, the final calibration assertion follows by the displayed deterministic rate substitution.
obligation.obstruction: The local rank-one calculation controls the oracle projector. The exact singular-value-thresholding fixed point does not by itself provide a simultaneous active-rank neighborhood, concentration of the overlapping centered quadratic aggregate, or plug-in control at the inverse-panel scale.
obligation.attempted: Computed the complete three-term differential and local quadratic contraction, checked the calibration array against the transfer theorem's geometric and probabilistic premises, and substituted its claimed raw rates. A direct use of proximal nonexpansiveness loses the averaging gain and leaves the penalty and fitted-Hessian terms uncontrolled.
obligation.partial_result:
The exact calibration calculation is complete:
\[
\frac{\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}}{\psi}
=\sqrt{\left(\frac34+\frac1n\right)
\left(\frac12+\frac{4p_t^2}{5n}\right)}
\longrightarrow\sqrt{\frac38}>\frac12.
\]
The exact rank-one projector expansion and contraction of the lag-zero and lag-one covariances give
\[
\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}\,
\mathbb E\!\left[
q_{it}\!\left(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}\epsilon\right)
\middle|M\right]
=-\frac{6\sqrt{3/2}}{5\sqrt5}\,p_t+O(n^{-1}),
\]
and hence
\[
\psi\,
\mathbb E\!\left[
q_{it}\!\left(P_{\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}}R_{it}\epsilon\right)
\middle|M\right]
\longrightarrow-\frac{12p_t}{5\sqrt5}.
\]
Because the consecutive window contains equally many even and odd indices,
\[
\psi B_2\longrightarrow-\frac{12}{5\sqrt5}.
\]
The calibration has donor and preperiod normalized Grams \(3/4\) and \(1/2\), local condition number one, incoherence bounded by \(9/5\), independent Gaussian one-dependent rows, and \(s^2\asymp(nH)^{-1}\).  It obeys the signal-window envelope for every fixed \(\eta\in(0,1/20)\).

If the raw conclusions of \(\mathrm{thm:native\mbox{-}second\mbox{-}order\mbox{-}transfer}\) hold, then with
\[
\mathcal R_n=
\frac1{gH}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it})
-L-\widehat B_2
\]
and \(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\ge n^{4/5}/2\), their decomposition and triangle inequality give
\[
\begin{aligned}
n|\mathcal R_n|
&\le n|Q-B_2|+n|R_{\mathrm{agg}}|+n|\widehat B_2-B_2|\\
&=O_{\mathbb P}\!\left(
\ell_n^4n^{-1/10}
+\ell_n^4n^{-3/10}
+\ell_n^4n^{-1/2}
+\ell_n^2n^{-3/10}
\right)
=o_{\mathbb P}(1).
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus the target's final assertion is an exact rate corollary of that sibling theorem.  What remains open is the native-optimizer proof of the raw bounds themselves.
